mapper.select:
WITH LatestDetection AS ( SELECT MAX(detected_at) as latest_time FROM apprisk_results WHERE mac_address = #{macAddress} ) SELECT
FROM apprisk_results ar LEFT JOIN apprisk a ON ar.apprisk_id = a.id WHERE ar.mac_address = #{macAddress} AND ar.detected_at = (SELECT latest_time FROM LatestDetection) ORDER BY ar.id ASC
